import importlib.util
import math
import pathlib
import unittest

import torch


SOURCE = pathlib.Path("/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_hyperbolic_item_semantic_id/model/hyperbolic.py")
_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate_hyperbolic", SOURCE)
_HYP = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(_HYP)


class HyperbolicReferenceMathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_origin_map_and_round_trip_numeric_reference(self):
        zero = torch.zeros(1, 32, dtype=torch.float64)
        v = torch.zeros(1, 32, dtype=torch.float64)
        v[0, 0] = 1.0
        mapped = _HYP.exp_0(v)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(_HYP.exp_0(zero).item(), 0.0, places=14)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mapped[0, 0].item(), math.tanh(1.0), places=14)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(_HYP.log_0(mapped)[0, 0].item(), 1.0, places=13)

    def test_collinear_distance_exact_reference(self):
        x = torch.zeros(1, 32, dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.zeros_like(x)
        x[0, 0] = 0.2
        y[0, 0] = 0.5
        # Mobius offset magnitude=(0.5-0.2)/(1-0.2*0.5)=1/3; D=2 atanh(1/3)=ln(2).
        actual = _HYP.hyperbolic_distance(x, y).item()
        self.assertAlmostEqual(actual, math.log(2.0), places=13)

    def test_distance_symmetry_and_identity(self):
        x = torch.zeros(2, 32, dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.zeros_like(x)
        x[0, 0], x[0, 1] = 0.2, -0.1
        y[0, 0], y[0, 1] = -0.15, 0.25
        x[1, 3] = 0.4
        y[1, 3] = 0.4
        dxy = _HYP.hyperbolic_distance(x, y)
        dyx = _HYP.hyperbolic_distance(y, x)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(dxy, dyx, atol=1e-13, rtol=1e-13))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(dxy[1].item(), 0.0, places=14)

    def test_mobius_add_origin_and_known_collinear_value(self):
        a = torch.zeros(1, 32, dtype=torch.float64)
        b = torch.zeros_like(a)
        a[0, 0], b[0, 0] = 0.2, 0.3
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(_HYP.mobius_add(a, torch.zeros_like(a)), a, atol=1e-14, rtol=0.0))
        # (a (+) b)=(a+b)/(1+ab) for collinear scalar points.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(_HYP.mobius_add(a, b)[0, 0].item(), 0.5 / 1.06, places=14)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
